items_all.title: Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem has "apparently been settled"
items_all.summary: The Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems worth $1 million each, has "apparently been settled." A formal review is now underway. The article Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem has "apparently been settled" appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 克雷數學研究所（Clay Mathematics Institute）表示，價值 100 萬美元的千禧年大獎問題之一「納維-斯托克斯方程式」（Navier-Stokes problem）已經「顯然獲得解決」。目前正在進行正式審查。這篇《克雷數學研究所稱納維-斯托克斯千禧年大獎問題「顯然獲得解決」》的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: China fires back at U.S. AI safety warnings, calling them fearmongering to lock in American advantage
items_all.summary: China has flatly rejected warnings about AI risks from Anthropic CEO Amodei and other U.S. AI leaders. Beijing's Foreign Ministry calls it "fearmongering," while the state-run Global Times accuses Amodei of waging a "silent AI Cold War." China's security minister isn't calling for a slowdown either but for faster AI infrastructure buildout. Trump also opposes any slowdown. The article China fires back at U.S. AI safety warnings, calling them fearmongering to lock in American advantage appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 中國直接拒絕了來自 Anthropic 執行長阿莫迪（Amodei）及其他美國人工智慧領袖關於 AI 風險的警告。北京外交部稱其為「散佈恐懼」，而官媒《環球時報》則指責阿莫迪發動「無聲的 AI 冷戰」。中國國家安全部也沒有呼籲放慢腳步，而是要求加快 AI 基礎設施建設。川普也反對任何放慢腳步的做法。這篇題為〈中國反擊美國的 AI 安全警告，稱其為鞏固美國優勢而散佈恐懼〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 美國國安局據傳推動大規模改組，將設五大任務中心強化網路安全與AI能力
items_all.summary: 美國國家安全局（NSA）據傳正在推動近10年來規模最大的組織改組。資安媒體《The Record》9月13日引述多名知情人士報導，NSA局長兼美國網路司令部司令Joshua Rudd本月稍早已向員工說明改組計畫，並啟動30天實施期限，改組目的是縮短情報從NSA傳遞至軍事作戰單位的時間，現有組織將改為五大任務中心，但NSA尚未就這次改組相關訊息提出公開說明。

OpenAI now runs safety checks before major training runs, and according to The Information, the company has been talking with Anthropic and Google for months about joint self-regulation. items_all.title: OpenAI揭露前沿AI安全新措施，川普反對AI發展速度減緩
items_all.summary: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman週日（9/13）揭露新的前沿AI安全措施，將原本主要在模型完成訓練後、部署前進行的安全評估，進一步提前至可能大幅提升模型能力的訓練之前。不過，美國總統川普同日反對因安全疑慮而降低AI發展速度，強調美國必須維持對中國的AI領先優勢。

items_all.summary: Anthropic CEO達裡奧·阿莫迪呼籲放緩前沿AI發展，提出以“可核驗性”為核心的三步方案：企業引入駐場第三方評估、美國與盟友協同、全球協作。他認為AI遞迴式自我改進已出現，6至12個月後智慧體或借殭屍網路控制網際網路，因此須放慢能力提升，將時間投入可靠性、對齊、可解釋性與測試評估。

items_all.summary: 大模型長任務中反覆“失憶”、遺忘目標，根源或在執行框架而非模型。AWS指南指出，淺層智慧體長週期會上下文溢位、受幹擾跑題、無法維持狀態；修復關鍵是管理除模型外一切的harness。新研究盤點多家主流框架，聚焦這層外殼，為長週期穩定執行提供思路。

items_all.summary: 谷歌 DeepMind 研究員喬希·恩格爾斯離職，加入獨立 AI 評估機構 METR。他稱未來五年 AI 系統造成巨大危害的概率“高得嚇人”，並因此拒絕 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 邀約，仍離開 DeepMind。此事加劇外界對 AI 研發速度與安全風險的擔憂。

items_all.title: A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth
items_all.summary: Yifan Zhang's Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) technical report proposes a causal encoder paired with a recurrent decoder that carries its final hidden state and layerwise sliding-window attention cache across every prompt and response token, with no reset at the serving boundary. The reference tied configuration uses 48 encoder and 48 decoder layers, executing 96 logical blocks per token while the state path grows to 48t decoder blocks after t tokens. The design also specifies hardware-aware execution around the recurrent core and an exact current-policy RL replay contract. No code, weights, or measured results are released yet. The post A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 張奕帆（Yifan Zhang）的循環迴圈 Transformer（RLT）技術報告提出了一個因果編碼器，搭配一個能在每個提示詞和回應 Token 之間攜帶其最終隱藏狀態與分層滑動視窗注意力快取之循環解碼器，在服務邊界處不會重置。參考繫結組態使用了 48 個編碼器與 48 個解碼器層，每個 Token 執行 96 個邏輯區塊，同時狀態路徑在經過 t 個 Token 後增長至 48t 個解碼器區塊。該設計也指定了環繞循環核心的硬體感知執行，以及精確的當前策略 RL 重播合約。目前尚未發布任何程式碼、權重或測量結果。本文轉載自 MarkTechPost，原標題為「A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth」。

items_all.title: commit-rewriter 0.1
items_all.summary: Release: commit-rewriter 0.1 I built this little web app the other day to help edit the commit messages for the Datasette security releases . The initial commits were full of coding agent cruft and references to issue IDs from our private repository, so they weren't fit for publication. If you want to edit the commit messages for a repository you can run it like this: uvx commit-rewriter path/to/repo Omit the path if you are already in the directory for that repo. When you submit your edits the tool creates a timestamped branch of your current repo state - to allow you to revert if you need to - and then rewrites every commit from the first one you edited to the most recent. Tags: git , projects , python , ai-assisted-programming

items_all.title: shot-scraper 1.12
items_all.summary: Release: shot-scraper 1.12 I've added WebP support to my shot-scraper screenshot automation tool. You can now take a WebP screenshot of a web page like this: shot-scraper https://simonwillison.net -o screenshot.webp --quality 80 The --quality option sets the quality - without that option the WebP file will be lossless. In my experience WebP screenshots are almost always significantly smaller in file size than their JPEG or PNG equivalents. See the PR for some examples. I shipped this feature so I could use it to generate the screenshot for my new commit-rewriter tool . Tags: playwright , shot-scraper

items_all_raw.title: China fires back at U.S. AI safety warnings, calling them fearmongering to lock in American advantage
items_all_raw.summary: China has flatly rejected warnings about AI risks from Anthropic CEO Amodei and other U.S. AI leaders. Beijing's Foreign Ministry calls it "fearmongering," while the state-run Global Times accuses Amodei of waging a "silent AI Cold War." China's security minister isn't calling for a slowdown either but for faster AI infrastructure buildout. Trump also opposes any slowdown. The article China fires back at U.S. AI safety warnings, calling them fearmongering to lock in American advantage appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 中國直接拒絕了來自 Anthropic 執行長阿莫迪（Amodei）及其他美國人工智慧領袖關於 AI 風險的警告。北京外交部稱其為「散佈恐懼」，而官媒《環球時報》則指責阿莫迪發動「無聲的 AI 冷戰」。中國國家安全部也沒有呼籲放慢腳步，而是要求加快 AI 基礎設施建設。川普也反對任何放慢腳步的做法。這篇題為〈中國反擊美國的 AI 安全警告，稱其為鞏固美國優勢而散佈恐懼〉的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 美國國家安全局（NSA）據傳正在推動近10年來規模最大的組織改組。資安媒體《The Record》9月13日引述多名知情人士報導，NSA局長兼美國網路司令部司令Joshua Rudd本月稍早已向員工說明改組計畫，並啟動30天實施期限，改組目的是縮短情報從NSA傳遞至軍事作戰單位的時間，現有組織將改為五大任務中心，但NSA尚未就這次改組相關訊息提出公開說明。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI揭露前沿AI安全新措施，川普反對AI發展速度減緩
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman週日（9/13）揭露新的前沿AI安全措施，將原本主要在模型完成訓練後、部署前進行的安全評估，進一步提前至可能大幅提升模型能力的訓練之前。不過，美國總統川普同日反對因安全疑慮而降低AI發展速度，強調美國必須維持對中國的AI領先優勢。

items_all_raw.summary: xAI首席執行官埃隆·馬斯克今日在X平臺透露，Grok 4.8將是一款參數量達2.5萬億的AI模型，且採用全新C++軟件棧訓練。他明確節點：本週完成訓練後隨即啓動強化學習。此前Grok 4.7原定9月12日發佈，後因強化學習環節延期數日。

items_all_raw.title: commit-rewriter 0.1
items_all_raw.summary: Release: commit-rewriter 0.1 I built this little web app the other day to help edit the commit messages for the Datasette security releases . The initial commits were full of coding agent cruft and references to issue IDs from our private repository, so they weren't fit for publication. If you want to edit the commit messages for a repository you can run it like this: uvx commit-rewriter path/to/repo Omit the path if you are already in the directory for that repo. When you submit your edits the tool creates a timestamped branch of your current repo state - to allow you to revert if you need to - and then rewrites every commit from the first one you edited to the most recent. Tags: git , projects , python , ai-assisted-programming

items_all_raw.title: shot-scraper 1.12
items_all_raw.summary: Release: shot-scraper 1.12 I've added WebP support to my shot-scraper screenshot automation tool. You can now take a WebP screenshot of a web page like this: shot-scraper https://simonwillison.net -o screenshot.webp --quality 80 The --quality option sets the quality - without that option the WebP file will be lossless. In my experience WebP screenshots are almost always significantly smaller in file size than their JPEG or PNG equivalents. See the PR for some examples. I shipped this feature so I could use it to generate the screenshot for my new commit-rewriter tool . Tags: playwright , shot-scraper

items_all_raw.title: A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth
items_all_raw.summary: Yifan Zhang's Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) technical report proposes a causal encoder paired with a recurrent decoder that carries its final hidden state and layerwise sliding-window attention cache across every prompt and response token, with no reset at the serving boundary. The reference tied configuration uses 48 encoder and 48 decoder layers, executing 96 logical blocks per token while the state path grows to 48t decoder blocks after t tokens. The design also specifies hardware-aware execution around the recurrent core and an exact current-policy RL replay contract. No code, weights, or measured results are released yet. The post A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 張奕帆（Yifan Zhang）的循環迴圈 Transformer（RLT）技術報告提出了一個因果編碼器，搭配一個能在每個提示詞和回應 Token 之間攜帶其最終隱藏狀態與分層滑動視窗注意力快取之循環解碼器，在服務邊界處不會重置。參考繫結組態使用了 48 個編碼器與 48 個解碼器層，每個 Token 執行 96 個邏輯區塊，同時狀態路徑在經過 t 個 Token 後增長至 48t 個解碼器區塊。該設計也指定了環繞循環核心的硬體感知執行，以及精確的當前策略 RL 重播合約。目前尚未發布任何程式碼、權重或測量結果。本文轉載自 MarkTechPost，原標題為「A Princeton Researcher Proposes Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) that Carries Decoder State across Every Token, Fixing 96 Blocks per Token with Unbounded Temporal Depth」。
